notes:
A bug audit across the whole app. Nothing new to learn; a lot that now does what it said.

- A proposal covering part of a bid printed the scoped list up top and the
  whole bid's Subtotal, Tax and Total underneath. It now totals what is on the
  page, tax included, and lists only the alternates in scope.

- Closing a window or a tab with unsaved markup asks first, every time. The
  question used to arrive after the window was already gone, so it never
  appeared, and the recovery copy was then deleted as "closed on purpose".

- A revision re-saved while a newer one exists on the folder (two Macs, one
  job) is no longer pruned the instant it is written; and the autosave stands
  down instead of writing over a revision another Mac made since.

- The buy list no longer orders material for alternates nobody took or change
  orders nobody signed. A purchase order that was never sent commits nothing.

- A trade that nets to a credit stays on the breakdown instead of vanishing
  and overstating the price by that amount. A negative amount prints with a
  plain hyphen, which is the one the PDF font can encode.

- Sending a proposal only counts as sent — and only bumps its revision — once
  the file is actually on disk.

- An installer staged for the next quit counts as staged, so the hourly check
  stops downloading the same one again every hour.

- Settings hand the licence record through to the app again.

- The Claude/MCP server had drifted from the app's money model: crew × days
  labor priced at $0, the plain-text takeoff crashed on any priced group, and
  the price book and cost codes were read from places the app stopped writing.
  All four match the app now.
